meta.description: WD-26. Daily: open pm_tasks with no work_activity in the last N=5 days -> notify the assignee; tasks stale >= 2N=10 days ALSO notify the project owner (escalation, in addition to the assignee, not instead of). Read (workActivity.staleTasks, which does the N/2N bucketing arithmetic in platform-nest so this flow stays read -> notify with no logic of its own) -> notify (in-app only, LOW impact, no medium+ write anywhere — DEF-3). Scoped identity wf:wd-stale-nag -> [workActivity.staleTasks, notify]. Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "workActivity.staleTasks", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, days: 5 } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: ($json.escalate ? "stale_task_escalation" : "stale_task_nag"), payload: { taskId: $json.taskId, title: $json.title, projectId: $json.projectId, projectName: $json.projectName, daysStale: $json.daysStale } } } }) }}
